test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The Indian Government has launched the National Rural Livelihoods Mission, a _______ programme aimed at reducing rural poverty.
solution:
The correct answer is: **flagship**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"flagship"** means the most important or leading member of a group, often used to describe the principal initiative or product of an organization. (प्रमुख)

 
 
• **Example:** The company's flagship store is located in New York City.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that the Indian government initiated the National Rural Livelihood Mission with the aim of reducing poverty in rural areas.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct answer to the given statement is **'flagship'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **flagship**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Controversial** (विवादास्पद): Giving rise or likely to give rise to public disagreement.

 
 
• **Example:** The new policy has become a controversial topic among the citizens.
 
 
 
• **Regressive** (प्रतिगामी): Becoming less advanced; returning to a former or less developed state.
 
 
• **Example:** The law is considered regressive as it takes away many of the rights that were previously granted.
 
 
 
• **Designer** (डिजाइनर): Intended to be fashionable or attractive.
 
 
• **Example:** She wore a designer dress to the party.
 
 

1cc:Tb22,

The correct answer is: Option 4<
